description: Every NFKC_Quick_Check value normalizes aliases through terminals, tests, patterns, conditions, filters, and caller tags.
grammar:
%rule text r0 r1 r2
%rule r0 $x:_NFKC_Quick_Check_Maybe<_NFKC_Quick_Check_Maybe>
%conditions $x ≅ #_NFKC_Quick_Check_Maybe<_NFKC_Quick_Check_Maybe>, _NFKC_Quick_Check_Maybe ⊆ $x.tags
%emits $x :: $x.tags ∩ _NFKC_Quick_Check_Maybe
%rule r1 $x:_NFKC_Quick_Check_No<_NFKC_Quick_Check_No>
%conditions $x ≅ #_NFKC_Quick_Check_No<_NFKC_Quick_Check_No>, _NFKC_Quick_Check_No ⊆ $x.tags
%emits $x :: $x.tags ∩ _NFKC_Quick_Check_No
%rule r2 $x:_NFKC_Quick_Check_Yes<_NFKC_Quick_Check_Yes>
%conditions $x ≅ #_NFKC_Quick_Check_Yes<_NFKC_Quick_Check_Yes>, _NFKC_Quick_Check_Yes ⊆ $x.tags
%emits $x :: $x.tags ∩ _NFKC_Quick_Check_Yes
